list-of-allocated-amateur-radio-callsign.contentsIndicative: one worksheet, 'Allocated CallSign as at 260320': header Value,Status then 92,318 data rows, Status 'Allocated' on every row. This is the faithful witness (Ofcom asset id 196168). A companion asset (id 194533, amateur-radio-allocated-call-signs.xlsx, sha256 8e7ddcfccc1a4d3f80a88e924f4a39297ba5142bf1b608bdedbc4dccfbc0638c, published at https://www.ofcom.org.uk/__data/assets/excel_doc/0025/194533/amateur-radio-allocated-call-signs.xlsx) carries the same 92,318 logical callsigns but with eleven suffix-month callsigns mangled by Excel into date serials (20JAN,21JAN,20FEB,20MAR,21MAR,20APR,20MAY,20JUL,20SEP,20OCT,20DEC -> 2020-01-20,2020-01-21,2020-02-20,2020-03-20,2020-03-21,2020-04-20,2020-05-20,2020-07-20,2020-09-20,2020-10-20,2020-12-20); it is not ingested (identical worksheet title would collide on extraction, and it is a strictly-corrupted variant). Anomalies in this faithful copy, preserved verbatim: three trailing non-breaking spaces (2E1HON, G0TQK, G7IWE), one interior space (G6 FMU), two non-uppercase callsigns (2e1GTD, g0jrk), 388 four-character heritage callsigns and 51 callsigns of six to nine characters (mostly reciprocal M/... forms).

raw-extract-sheet-1-allocated-callsign-a.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the sole worksheet; header Value,Status then 92,318 rows. Status 'Allocated' throughout. All anomalies preserved verbatim (trailing non-breaking spaces, interior space, non-uppercase callsigns, heritage four-character and over-length reciprocal callsigns).

normalised--sheet-1-allocated-callsign-a.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class; 92,318 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status carried verbatim ('Allocated' on every row - a genuine per-row column, not a declared attribution); licence_class emitted empty (no class disclosed). Three trailing non-breaking spaces were trimmed from callsigns and counted in the converter notes (never silent); the interior-space 'G6 FMU' and the non-uppercase callsigns are preserved verbatim.
